entities.name: HIV-1 Vif
observations: 192-aa query matches reviewed HIV-1 Vif references at 82.7–87.4% identity with 99.0–99.5% query coverage; Vif Pfam domain spans residues 1–192.

Reviewed reference annotations describe Vif as an adaptor/substrate-recognition component of a host CUL5-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complex that promotes APOBEC3F/3G ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation.
Reference annotations place Vif in host cytoplasm, on the cytoplasmic side of host membranes, and in virions; GO process annotation includes viral life cycle.

entities.name: APOBEC3G
observations: Reviewed HIV-1 Vif reference annotations report APOBEC3G as a host antiviral target; Vif promotes its ubiquitination/degradation and may also inhibit its cytidine deaminase activity.

entities.name: APOBEC3F
observations: Reviewed HIV-1 Vif reference annotations report APOBEC3F as a host antiviral target for Vif-mediated ubiquitination and degradation.
